SELECT c.id, c.post_id, c.user_id, c.parent_id, c.reply_to_id, c.content, c.html_content, c.like_count, c.dislike_count, c.reply_count, c.level, c.path, c.status, c.is_pinned, c.is_author_reply, c.edited_at, c.created_at, c.updated_at,
-- 用户基本信息 u.id AS user_id, u.username AS user_username, up.display_name AS user_display_name, up.avatar_url AS user_avatar_url, up.bio AS user_bio, u.status AS user_status, u.created_at AS user_created_at, -- 判断评论用户是否为当前文章的作者 CASE WHEN p.author_id = c.user_id THEN true ELSE false END AS user_is_blog_author
FROM comments c LEFT JOIN "user" u ON c.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN user_profiles up ON u.id = up.user_id LEFT JOIN posts p ON c.post_id = p.id WHERE c.parent_id = #{parentId} AND c.post_id = #{postId} AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.status = 'APPROVED' ORDER BY c.created_at ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT c.id, c.post_id, c.user_id, c.parent_id, c.reply_to_id, c.content, c.html_content, c.like_count, c.dislike_count, c.reply_count, c.level, c.path, c.status, c.is_pinned, c.is_author_reply, c.edited_at, c.created_at, c.updated_at,
-- 用户基本信息 u.id AS user_id, u.username AS user_username, up.display_name AS user_display_name, up.avatar_url AS user_avatar_url, up.bio AS user_bio, u.status AS user_status, u.created_at AS user_created_at, -- 判断评论用户是否为当前文章的作者 CASE WHEN p.author_id = c.user_id THEN true ELSE false END AS user_is_blog_author
FROM comments c LEFT JOIN "user" u ON c.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN user_profiles up ON u.id = up.user_id LEFT JOIN posts p ON c.post_id = p.id WHERE c.id = #{commentId} AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT id, title, slug FROM posts WHERE id = #{postId} AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT c.id, c.post_id, c.user_id, c.parent_id, c.reply_to_id, c.content, c.html_content, c.like_count, c.dislike_count, c.reply_count, c.level, c.path, c.status, c.is_pinned, c.is_author_reply, c.edited_at, c.created_at, c.updated_at,
-- 用户基本信息 u.id AS user_id, u.username AS user_username, up.display_name AS user_display_name, up.avatar_url AS user_avatar_url, up.bio AS user_bio, u.status AS user_status, u.created_at AS user_created_at, -- 判断评论用户是否为当前文章的作者 CASE WHEN p.author_id = c.user_id THEN true ELSE false END AS user_is_blog_author
FROM comments c LEFT JOIN "user" u ON c.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN user_profiles up ON u.id = up.user_id LEFT JOIN posts p ON c.post_id = p.id WHERE c.parent_id = #{parentId} AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.status = 'APPROVED' ORDER BY c.created_at ASC

SELECT cr.id AS report_id, cr.comment_id, c.content AS comment_content, cr.reason, cr.description, cr.status, cr.handled_by, cr.handled_at, cr.handle_note, cr.created_at,
-- 评论作者信息 cu.id AS comment_author_id, cu.username AS comment_author_username, cup.display_name AS comment_author_display_name, cup.avatar_url AS comment_author_avatar_url, cup.bio AS comment_author_bio, cu.status AS comment_author_status, cu.created_at AS comment_author_created_at, CASE WHEN p.author_id = cu.id THEN true ELSE false END AS comment_author_is_blog_author,
-- 举报人信息 ru.id AS reporter_id, ru.username AS reporter_username, rup.display_name AS reporter_display_name, rup.avatar_url AS reporter_avatar_url, rup.bio AS reporter_bio, ru.status AS reporter_status, ru.created_at AS reporter_created_at, CASE WHEN p.author_id = ru.id THEN true ELSE false END AS reporter_is_blog_author
FROM comment_reports cr LEFT JOIN comments c ON cr.comment_id = c.id LEFT JOIN "user" cu ON c.user_id = cu.id LEFT JOIN user_profiles cup ON cu.id = cup.user_id LEFT JOIN "user" ru ON cr.reporter_id = ru.id LEFT JOIN user_profiles rup ON ru.id = rup.user_id LEFT JOIN posts p ON c.post_id = p.id WHERE c.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY cr.created_at DESC
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cr.comment_id) FROM comment_reports cr LEFT JOIN comments c ON cr.comment_id = c.id WHERE c.deleted_at IS NULL
